request.style: English, Male baritone solo with supporting choir, organ, strings, piano, acoustic guitar, majestic and hopeful mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I am not ashamed of the good news
It carries the power of God
For the salvation of all who believe
From the first to the last

[Chorus]
It is the power of God for salvation
Of everyone who believes in Him
Righteousness is revealed in the gospel
From faith to faith it comes

[Verse]
I have been prevented from coming to you
But I am eager to preach the truth
To the wise and to the foolish alike
I am under this obligation

[Chorus]
It is the power of God for salvation
Of everyone who believes in Him
Righteousness is revealed in the gospel
From faith to faith it comes

[Bridge]
The righteous will live by faith
As it is written in scripture
God has made it plain to them
What can be known is clear

[Chorus]
It is the power of God for salvation
Of everyone who believes in Him
Righteousness is revealed in the gospel
From faith to faith it comes

[Outro]
First for the Jew and then the Greek
The power of God is real
